Container.Name: marquee
Container.Overview:
Marquee: movies and TV for your home server in one app. Requests, finding the right copy, downloads and who's watching, explained in plain English. Replaces Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr, Seerr and Tautulli (in progress).
After installing, open the WebUI and create the admin account. Pocket ID (OIDC) and Plex sign-in are optional: fill in the variables under "Show more settings".

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port for the Marquee web app.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Your TRaSH-style data share, containing torrents/ and media/movies, media/tv. Must be one share so hardlinks work. Library folders can be changed in Settings → Services.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID Marquee runs as. 99 is Unraid's 'nobody'.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID Marquee runs as. 100 is Unraid's 'users'.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File permission mask for files Marquee creates.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for schedules and times shown in the app.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address you open Marquee at from outside, e.g. https://marquee.example.com. Needed for Pocket ID behind Pangolin/NPM. Leave blank if you only use the LAN address.

Config.Name: TMDB API key
Config.Description: From themoviedb.org → Settings → API. The v3 API key or the v4 read access token both work. Used to match your library (Milestone 1).

Config.Name: OIDC issuer URL
Config.Description: Pocket ID's base URL, e.g. https://id.example.com. Fill this, the client ID and secret to show the sign-in button.

Config.Name: OIDC client ID
Config.Description: Client ID from the OIDC client you create for Marquee. Callback URL to register: [Public URL]/api/auth/oidc/callback

Config.Name: OIDC client secret
Config.Description: Client secret from the OIDC client.

Config.Name: OIDC auto-create accounts
Config.Description: true: anyone who can sign in to Pocket ID gets a member account. false: only accounts you've linked can sign in.

Config.Name: Plex sign-in
Config.Description: true shows 'Continue with Plex'. People link their Plex account under Settings → Account.

Config.Name: Plex server ID
Config.Description: Your Plex server's machine identifier (open http://[plex-ip]:32400/identity). Only needed for auto-create.

Config.Name: Plex auto-create accounts
Config.Description: true: anyone your Plex server is shared with can sign in and gets a member account. Needs Plex server ID.
